long_biography.plain_text:
Profit Insight's 2014 rebrand placed Cliff McKee at the centre of a firm evolving beyond its Profit Technologies name. As vice-chairman, he described a performance-based model: the consultancy was paid when its work improved financial institutions' earnings, using proprietary analysis to identify revenue gains and operating savings.

Now chairman after serving as chief executive, McKee oversees global services, product development, partnerships and corporate strategy. He has served as a director of the British company since 1998 and is its controlling shareholder. His career has moved from hands-on leadership toward strategic oversight, while the firm continues to advise banks, card issuers and payment businesses internationally.
